environment.description: Same application container image deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB. The ALB has an associated AWS WAFv2 WebACL. The WebACL includes three rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet at priority 100 with SizeRestriction_QUERYSTRING rule in COUNT mode only, (2) a custom rule group 'app-input-validation' at priority 200 containing a single rule that blocks requests where any single query string parameter value exceeds 64 bytes (action: BLOCK, field: SingleQueryArgument 'q', size constraint: GT 64, text transformation: URL_DECODE then LOWERCASE), (3) AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet at priority 300 but with SQLi_QUERYARGUMENTS overridden to COUNT mode. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint via security group reference. CloudWatch Logs Insights query runs every 5 minutes looking for audit_log entries with suspicious patterns but takes no automated action.

config.network: private subnet, NAT gateway egress restricted to RDS SG only via task SG
config.monitoring: CloudWatch Logs Insights scheduled query every 5min (alerting only, no block)
